findings.title: Invalidate the persisted gate when execution provenance fails
findings.body: If a tracked source file changes during execution, this check raises after the worker has already persisted `status: "complete"` and potentially `gate.pass: true`. The command fails, but the result artifact still advertises a successful run with invalid provenance. Before raising, persist a failed/incomplete status and a nonpassing gate so consumers of `results.json` cannot accept the rejected run.

overall_explanation: The fixed ridge objective, shared design, target isolation, metrics, bootstrap, and gate match the frozen contract on inspection. However, a detected execution-provenance failure leaves a potentially passing persisted result. No tests or real-data fitting were run.
